pill.comment: Pill/badge radius, carried over unchanged from the previous chip treatment

hairline.comment: Default hard border width for window-chrome and flat cards

sticker.comment: One hard offset shadow, used sparingly on interactive cards in place of soft elevation. References --color-ink directly (not a resolved value) so it stays correct if ink ever changes. This is an original addition, not a literal typesafe.ai pattern — their depth comes from window z-stacking, which doesn't translate directly to a card grid.
